column1: # Lua binding registry of the 3.3.5a client (WoW.exe build 12340): exact names, functions and table membership.
# 113 registrar tables, 2987 bindings, 2828 with CFG-proven return arity. The 73 RegisterFunction loop
# sites at 0x817f90 supply exact global table extents; 39 calls to 0x8167e0 supply exact widget
# method extents; seven null-terminated `.rdata` tables are the FrameScript base and Lua 5.1 libraries.
# All rows have an observed argc floor and 2445 have an independent return-kind trace. Arity is
# exact when every reachable ret has one constant, a sound `|`-set when paths differ, and unknown
# when EAX or control flow cannot be proved. argc is never gateable: even `exact` means only that every
# stack-index API observed in this body used a constant; an opaque helper makes it a `lower-bound`.
# kinds_conf=agree means the known Lua-stack suffix covers every returned slot. `delegated-push` rows
# describe only the binding's own visible stack effects and remain advisory.
